name: What happens if my current home doesn't appraise for the expected value?

mainEntity.name: What happens if my current home doesn't appraise for the expected value?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your current home's appraisal comes in lower than anticipated, it can affect the offer from a trade-in program. In such cases, there are typically options to discuss with your real estate professional. This might involve renegotiating the offer, exploring alternative selling strategies, or re-evaluating your new home budget. A practical tradeoff is balancing a quick, guaranteed sale with potentially maximizing your home's equity through a longer, traditional market listing. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution will guide you through these choices to find the best path forward.
acceptedAnswer.description: A lower appraisal can affect the offer. We will discuss options like renegotiating, exploring other strategies, or adjusting your new home budget to find the best solution.
